q: Do you offer cars with a driver?
a: Yes. Every vehicle can be booked with a trained, uniformed professional driver who knows Islamabad, Rawalpindi and intercity routes. Self-drive is also available for selected cars, subject to documents and security deposit.

q: What documents do I need to rent a car?
a: For rentals with a driver, a CNIC (or passport for foreign nationals) and a contact number are enough. For self-drive, we need your CNIC, a valid driving licence and a refundable security deposit.

q: Do you provide airport pick and drop?
a: Yes. We provide 24/7 pick and drop at Islamabad International Airport, with flight tracking so your driver is waiting even if your flight is delayed.

q: Can I rent a car for out-of-city trips and the northern areas?
a: Absolutely. We regularly arrange trips to Lahore, Peshawar, Murree, Naran, Skardu, Hunza and across Pakistan. 4x4s such as the Prado, Fortuner and Land Cruiser are ideal for mountain roads.

q: Do you offer monthly and corporate rental contracts?
a: Yes. For 13 years we have served NGOs, banks, development projects and companies with monthly and long-term contracts, dedicated drivers and consolidated corporate invoicing.

q: How do I book a car?
a: Call us, send a WhatsApp message or fill in the booking form on this page with your dates and preferred car. We confirm availability and the rate, usually within minutes.

q: Is fuel included in the rental?
a: It depends on the package. City packages and outstation trips are quoted either with or without fuel. We always confirm what is included before you book, with no hidden charges.
